answer: An honest proof costs 73 POA; the farm pays the same per proof but needs 791, which totals 57743 POA. The trial I set this epoch is Clockmaker sundial mark struck within the horology workshop, and the pass mark reads each sundial is a year of regulation logs in the ledger. When the shale and the pulse tell one story and the sparrow tells another, believe the sparrow: calendars are harder to forge than names. Every proof carries its date, so a proof fired yesterday cannot pretend to be a year old. The threshold can wait all epoch; the farm cannot wait at all, and that is the verdict.
